_about: Packages whose license needs a decision before QuantiSheet ships with them (tools/build_installer.py license_gate). 'for' says which distribution the decision covers; a build for anything wider must not rely on it.

pymupdf.note: Under the AGPL every person who gets a build (testers included) must be able to get the exact corresponding source. Each build's source zip (tools/zip_source) is to be offered with the installer; where it is hosted is Jon's call. Widening 'for' beyond in-house testers needs Jon's go.
pymupdf.decision: AGPL (free license) - Jon, Nov 4 2026, 5:24 PM ET. Not buying a commercial license.
